custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a part, part A, at the test location.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425719-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425719-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 3:

  • There is no Part Library or Catalog Part field and no way to pick a different library entry: Part Number is a plain text field.

Step 4:

  • The window closes without saving.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog), story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S13-E1: “Pointing a part at a different Part Library entry is not offered in the part dialog, and the system refuses it by any other route. Re-importing a part through the parts CSV import with a fully different old number creates a separate part under the old number. Both are for the merge and duplicate tool (Out of scope).”
  • Key Decisions: “Pointing a part at a different Part Library entry is removed from the part dialog. The dialog has no Part Library selector, and the system refuses a re-point by any other route. The merge and duplicate tool (Out of scope) is where that will live.”
  • S7-R2: “The dialog has no Part Library selector and no Part Library lookup step.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
